posts.text: The White House and the Pentagon’s top general are urging Congress to renew Section 702 of FISA (the foreign international surveillance act) which allows warrantless surveillance.  Sec. 702 of FISA has been tied to thousands of FBI searches for communications by journalists, activists and politicians in the USA, who shouldn’t be in the FISA database.

Donald Trump shared an image of himself appearing as Jesus and healing a person while holding a beam of light.  Many reacted in disdain, but just as many say their support of Trump has not changed, even if this has happened.

A federal judge in Florida dismissed the $10 billion defamation lawsuit filed by Trump against the WSJ, Murdoch, Dow Chemicals and others for the article about Trump’s bawdy birthday card written to Epstein  The Court said that the plaintiff was not able to prove actual malice.

Did NYC mayor Zohran Mamdani issue an order barring people from the city’s celebration for the 250th Annivesary in New York City on July 4? No. Unlike people like @🇺🇸Jenn🇺🇸 say, that’s not what the order is about.
So… teen pregnancy is down 7% since last year and 70% in the last 20 years… and FoxNews and conservative pundits are complaining about it

Starting this year, the government will start automatically registering 18 year old citizens and qualifying residents for the Selective Service, also known as the draft.  The question to ask is: if they have the information that allows them to   automatically register men to war, why can’t they do it for people to vote? With @themeghanelinor

Free speech has its limits.  Both the USA and the UK make it a crime to send specific types of Communication, even through social media, when that communication crosses the line and isn’t just personal opinion.  Let’s fact check @Patriotic Peach

Senate Republicans like Susan Collins are cashing in from the war in Iran. While her stock investments are officially held by her husband, the holdings in oil stock made Senator Collins $24,000 in a single month.  Collins’ household also owns military companies stock.

The Trump administration has indicated that it will keep the $70 million luxury jet that Kristi Noem purchased for use by Melania Trump and other senior staff. The luxury Boeing 737 includes a queen size bed, a cocktail bar, and multiple large screen TVs.

Vice President JD Vance says that Iran misunderstood the terms of the ceasefire and that the agreement never included Lebanon.  However, Pakistan’s Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif posted about it shortly after the agreement was finalized and included the Trump top cabinet in the communication.
